## Boundaries

- The universal Machine Commerce human handoff is live-verified and creates no checkout or payment.
- The product-specific public checkout route is not represented as live until an independent canary passes.
- Checkout creation is not payment proof.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
- No production access, upgrade, cutover, or destructive change is authorized by public discovery or purchase of the bounded diagnostic.
- Exact upgrade paths remain unknown until the authorized estate is inspected.

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents. Surface the smallest sufficient offer first. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Never infer private IBM i estate details.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
